calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract the same-day cross-sectional median 10-day return and negate the residual; divide by trailing 20-day realized volatility. Positive values favor assets that underperformed peers over 10 days, with risk normalization. All inputs are lag-safe at the decision date.

validation.period: 2025-01-01 through 2027-02-25 (available history; signal becomes valid after 20 observations)
validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark gates on the daily horizon across 142 dates and about 14.3 of 15 instruments per date. 2025-2026 5-day IC was +0.09489 (104 dates), but 2027 5-day IC was -0.05922 (34 dates); treat as regime-sensitive and revalidate promptly.
